project_type: Next.js 15/16 App Router fullstack (TypeScript strict), PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM, Tailwind v4
build_system: npm + next build; no tailwind.config.js — tokens live in @theme{} block of src/app/globals.css; path alias @/* → ./src/*
test_framework: none — verification is: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) then npm run build
verification_instructions: Run `npm run typecheck` (must emit 0 errors), then `npm run build` (must succeed). No automated test suite exists.
environment_constraints: Windows workspace path contains a space: 'child-trust-fund-platform (1)'. Always quote paths. DATABASE_URL and SESSION_SECRET env vars required at runtime but not for typecheck/build.
contribution_requirements: Money stored as integer cents. Never floats. No full SSNs or bank passwords stored. Prototype disclaimer in SiteFooter must be kept. All DB-backed pages must use force-dynamic. Route handlers stay thin: parse → call service → shape response.
key_patterns: Client components marked 'use client' at top. Server components are the default. Shared UI primitives in src/components/ui.tsx. CSS uses usa-* / gov-* class prefixes defined as plain CSS in globals.css. API success: { ok: true, ...payload } 201 for creation. Validation failure: { ok: false, errors: {fieldName: msg} } 422. Money fields end in Cents. Dollar-facing inputs named amountDollars.
directory_structure: src/app — Next.js App Router pages and API routes. src/components — client+server React components. src/lib — business logic (program.ts rules, service.ts all DB access, auth.ts crypto helpers, states.ts jurisdictions). src/db — Drizzle schema + pg pool. public/img — static seals.
